newsitem.title: ISRAEL: TEL AVIV STOCK EXCHANGE CLOSED FOR HOLIDAY.
newsitem.headline: TEL AVIV STOCK EXCHANGE CLOSED FOR HOLIDAY.

text.p: Israel's stock and bond markets will be closed on Tuesday in honour of the Jewish fast day of Tisha B'Av.
The benchmark Mishtanim index of the top 100 shares on Monday lost 1.21 percent, or 3.70 points, to 302.82 on a low all-share turnover of 143 million shekels against 139 million shekels on Sunday.
The Maof 25 blue chip index closed 1.05 percent lower at 308.75.
On the foreign exchange market, the central bank will not set representative rates for the shekel.
Normal trading will resume on Wednesday.
